records.jp: やっぱ広いお風呂はいいねぇ
records.en_original: Ahh, I love a big, wide-open bath.
records.en: Ahh, I love a big, wide-open bath.

records.jp: スーパー銭湯でも<CR>ここまで広いお風呂は中々ないもんね
records.en_original: You don't even see baths this big at spa resorts.
records.en: You don't even see baths this big at spa resorts.

records.jp: そうだね。むしろ広すぎるくらい
records.en_original: You're right. It might even be too big.
records.en: You're right. It might even be too big.

records.jp: あ、そうだ。このプールをいくつかに区切って、<CR>色んな種類のお風呂を作るってのは？
records.en_original: Hmm. Why don't we divide the pool into separate areas and have different types of baths?
records.en: Hmm. Why don't we divide the pool into separate areas and have different types of baths?

records.jp: 例えば？
records.en_original: What did you have in mind?
records.en: What did you have in mind?

records.jp: ジェットバスなんてどうよ
records.en_original: How about a jetted tub?
records.en: How about a jetted tub?

records.jp: 悪くないけど、どうやってその仕組みを設置するの？
records.en_original: That's a good idea, but how would you make one?
records.en: That's a good idea, but how would you make one?

records.jp: うーん、水鉄砲を水中で撃つとか
records.en_original: Umm, we could shoot water guns underwater.
records.en: Umm, we could shoot water guns underwater.

records.jp: まさかの手動！？
records.en_original: By hand?!
records.en: By hand?!

records.jp: 変わり湯は？
records.en_original: How about a bunch of baths with different fragrances?
records.en: How about a bunch of baths with different fragrances?

records.jp: でも入浴剤なんてここにはないでしょ
records.en_original: We don't have any bath salts, though.
records.en: We don't have any bath salts, though.

records.jp: そこは伶那さんの科学技術で
records.en_original: Can't you science something up, Rena?
records.en: Can't you science something up, Rena-san?

records.jp: あのね、科学ってつければ<CR>何でもできるわけじゃないから
records.en_original: You know, science doesn't mean you can just do anything.
records.en: You know, science doesn't mean you can just do anything.

records.jp: 頼りにしてるよ伶那さん
records.en_original: I'm counting on you, Rena.
records.en: I'm counting on you, Rena-san.

records.jp: お断りします
records.en_original: I'm afraid I'll have to say no.
records.en: I'm afraid I'll have to say no.

records.jp: ちぇー
records.en_original: Aww...
records.en: Aww...

records.jp: でもいいよね、こういうお風呂が身近にあって<CR>入り放題なの
records.en_original: Still, it's great being able to use a bath like this whenever we want.
records.en: Still, it's great being able to use a bath like this whenever we want.

records.jp: 小さい頃、銭湯に住んだら楽しそうとか<CR>考えたことあったけど、叶っちゃった
records.en_original: When I was little I thought it would be so fun to live in a bathhouse. My dream finally came true.
records.en: When I was little I thought it would be so fun to live in a bathhouse. My dream finally came true.

records.jp: 星崎さんも１回くらい考えたことない？
records.en_original: Have you ever had that thought, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Have you ever had that thought, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: あるよ。毎日こんなお風呂入れるって思ったら<CR>お風呂大好きになっちゃうよね
records.en_original: For sure. If I could take a bath like this every day, I'd love baths.
records.en: For sure. If I could take a bath like this every day, I'd love baths.

records.jp: そうそう。<CR>ただ、人が多い時に入るのはごめんだけど
records.en_original: Definitely. I wouldn't want to take a bath when it's crowded, though.
records.en: Definitely. I wouldn't want to take a bath when it's crowded, though.

records.jp: その点ここはいいよね。<CR>常にほぼ貸し切り状態！
records.en_original: That's why it's nice here. We always have the place to ourselves!
records.en: That's why it's nice here. We always have the place to ourselves!

records.jp: あなたと入ると賑やかさは変わらないけどね
records.en_original: Yeah, but you make as much noise as a crowd would.
records.en: Yeah, but you make as much noise as a crowd would.

records.jp: このくらいは心地よいＢＧＭでしょ
records.en_original: Think of it as ambiance.
records.en: Think of it as ambiance.

records.jp: まったく、いいように言って……
records.en_original: Psh, you would put it that way...
records.en: Psh, you would put it that way...

records.jp: ないなぁ
records.en_original: Not really.
records.en: Not really.

records.jp: でも意外。<CR>伶那さんってそんなこと考えるんだ
records.en_original: But I never knew you thought about things like that, Rena.
records.en: But I never knew you thought about things like that, Rena-san.

records.jp: お風呂入ってる間暇だし
records.en_original: There's nothing else to do while sitting in the bath.
records.en: There's nothing else to do while sitting in the bath.

records.jp: 他にも、もし無防備な今不審者が入ってきたら<CR>どう動くか、とか考えてた
records.en_original: Sometimes I think about what I would do if someone suspicious walked in while I was in the bath, naked and vulnerable.
records.en: Sometimes I think about what I would do if someone suspicious walked in while I was in the bath, naked and vulnerable.

records.jp: 想像力豊かだね。<CR>小説家とか漫画家に向いてそう
records.en_original: You have quite the imagination. You'd be a good writer—or manga artist.
records.en: You have quite the imagination. You'd be a good writer—or manga artist.

records.jp: そ、そう？<CR>まぁ、褒め言葉として受け取っておく
records.en_original: Y-you think so? I guess I'll take that as a compliment.
records.en: Y-you think so? I guess I'll take that as a compliment.

records.jp: あ、そうだ。伶那さん、タイム計ってほしいんだけど
records.en_original: Oh, I almost forgot. Rena, could you time me?
records.en: Oh, I almost forgot. Rena-san, could you time me?

records.jp: もしかして今から泳ぐ気？
records.en_original: Are you planning to swim laps?
records.en: Are you planning to swim laps?

records.jp: だってここプールだよ？
records.en_original: It's a pool, isn't it?
records.en: It's a pool, isn't it?

records.jp: そう言われればそうだけど
records.en_original: I guess so, but...
records.en: I guess so, but...

records.jp: 伶那さんも泳ぐ？
records.en_original: Come join me, Rena.
records.en: Come join me, Rena-san.

records.jp: 私は疲れを取りにきただけだから遠慮する
records.en_original: I came here to relax, so I'll pass.
records.en: I came here to relax, so I'll pass.

records.jp: そっか、残念だなぁ。伶那さんと並んで泳いだ方が<CR>タイム上がりそうだと思ったんだけど
records.en_original: Oh, that's too bad. I thought I'd improve my time if you were swimming alongside me.
records.en: Oh, that's too bad. I thought I'd swim faster with you beside me, Rena-san.

records.jp: こっちにも準備ってものがあるの
records.en_original: Fine. I'll be ready to join you next time.
records.en: Fine. I'll be ready to join you next time.

records.jp: やっぱ伶那さん優しい♪
records.en_original: Yay, Rena! I knew you were nice.
records.en: Yay, Rena-san! I knew you were nice.

records.jp: （でも伶那さんの性格上、前もって言ったら<CR>マジで身体仕上げてきそうだなぁ）
records.en_original: (But Rena being Rena, she'll probably do some serious training in preparation.)
records.en: (But Rena-san being Rena, she'll probably do some serious training in preparation.)

records.jp: ビーチボールやエアーマットもあるよ
records.en_original: There's a beach ball and an inflatable mattress too.
records.en: There's a beach ball and an inflatable mattress too.

records.jp: 遊ぶ気満々じゃん……
records.en_original: Always goofing around, aren't you?
records.en: Always goofing around, aren't you?

records.jp: いいじゃん。他に誰もいないんだし
records.en_original: It's fine! No one else is here.
records.en: It's fine! No one else is here.

records.jp: 私がいるんだけど
records.en_original: I'm here...
records.en: I'm here...

records.jp: 私は知ってるよ、伶那さんはなんだかんだ<CR>ノリが良い人だってこと
records.en_original: I know you've got a playful side, Rena.
records.en: I know you've got a playful side, Rena-san.

records.jp: 空気入れどこ？
records.en_original: Where's the air pump?
records.en: Where's the air pump?

records.jp: やったぁ！
records.en_original: Yaaaay!
records.en: Yaaaay!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
